clue.text: Ferret to graze on food underground

parts.note: to ferret is to root about, searching
animals crop grass when they graze on it

explanation.surface: A ferret is sent out to nibble at something buried below the earth.
explanation.definitionFit: A root crop such as a carrot or turnip is grown for the edible part that swells below the soil.

clue.text: Headstrong, like horse at end of run

indicators.note: at end of says the following pieces come after the letter for run

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run
as means like
H is slang for heroin, which is also called horse

explanation.surface: A wilful rider is like a horse finishing a race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horse' is drug slang for heroin, abbreviated H.
explanation.definitionFit: Rash describes acting impulsively, without thought, as a headstrong person does.

clue.text: Where bee maybe lands later, conserving energy, and distracted

indicators.note: conserving means keeping inside, so the letter for energy is held within

parts.note: a bee moves between flowers, so later it lands on another plant
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Describes a bee's flight between plants, then calls it scatterbrained.
explanation.walkthrough: The E goes into PLANT to make PLANET.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone said to be on another planet is absent-minded, their thoughts far away.

clue.text: Convincingly firm without using force

parts.note: CO, company, is a firm
gently means softly, without force

explanation.surface: Persuasion done firmly yet with no forcefulness.
explanation.definitionFit: A cogent argument is persuasive and compelling, so cogently means persuasively.

clue.text: Bad boy out of bounds climbing tree

indicators.note: climbing in a down clue means going upwards, so the letters read from the bottom up

parts.note: evil means bad

indicators.note: with its bounds, the first and last letters, removed, only the centre of boy is left

explanation.surface: A naughty boy goes where he shouldn't and climbs a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: EVIL plus O (boy without its ends) is read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The olive is a Mediterranean evergreen tree grown for its fruit and oil.

clue.text: Gastropods which exhausted deer

indicators.note: exhausted means emptied out, so only the shell of the word which, its outer letters, is left

parts.note: elks are large deer

explanation.surface: Asks which snails tired out some deer, an absurd natural-history puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: Whelks are sea snails, and snails belong to the mollusc class of gastropods.

clue.text: Tribute paid in silver blocks

indicators.note: blocks means obstructs from within, so the silver sits inside the word for in

parts.note: at home means in, so home can mean in
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A tribute is paid out in bars of silver.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is read as at home, as in 'staying in'; 'paid' just completes the phrase 'tribute paid'.
explanation.definitionFit: Homage is respect shown publicly, a tribute to someone admired.

clue.text: Legal restrictions on motor ignition when machines are running?

definitions.text: Legal restrictions on motor ignition when machines are running?

parts.words: Legal restrictions on motor ignition when machines are running?
parts.note: the official hours after dusk when vehicles must show lights, read as rules about starting engines

explanation.walkthrough: 'ignition' suggests engines, but the lighting in question is the headlamps that must be switched on at night.
explanation.definitionFit: These are the legally set hours, from sunset to sunrise, when road vehicles must have their lamps lit.

clue.text: Stage drama at last before players collectively resign

parts.note: a stand is a stage or platform

indicators.note: at last points to the final letter of drama

parts.note: a side is a team of players

explanation.surface: A stage drama finishes, then the whole cast quits.
explanation.definitionFit: To stand aside is to step down from a post and let another take over.

clue.text: Classification charge possible? I'm dismayed

parts.note: a tax is a charge levied
on means feasible, as in 'that's not on'
O my is an exclamation of dismay

explanation.surface: Someone hears a fee might be levied and cries out in dismay.
explanation.definitionFit: Taxonomy is the science of ordering living things into ranked groups.

clue.text: Fabulous land sharing supply almost everyone rejected

indicators.note: read as supple-ly, i.e. bendily, so the letters of sharing are bent into a new order
rejected means thrown back, so the shortened word is read backwards
almost means not quite complete, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: all means everyone

explanation.surface: Describes a legendary country where people share supplies, though almost everyone has turned the idea down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supply' looks like a noun but is read as the adverb from supple, bendily, which is why it signals rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Shangri-La is the imaginary Himalayan paradise of James Hilton's novel Lost Horizon, a place of fable.

clue.text: Hot stuff from graduates, with good intervention

indicators.note: intervention means coming between, so the letter for good goes between the two graduates

parts.note: two MAs, Masters of Arts, are graduates

explanation.surface: Something exciting is produced by university graduates once a good person steps in.
explanation.definitionFit: Magma is the molten rock beneath the earth's crust, literally very hot material.

clue.text: Report of singular advance

indicators.note: a report is something heard, so the word for singular is taken by its sound

parts.note: lone means single, singular

explanation.surface: A news report about one unusual step forward.
explanation.definitionFit: An advance of money is a sum lent ahead of time, which is a loan.

clue.text: Stretched leaders of one Nazi group cracking up

indicators.note: cracking means breaking into, so the initials go inside the word for up

parts.note: up means cheerful, elated

indicators.note: leaders are the front letters of one, Nazi and group

explanation.surface: A political group's leaders are under strain and breaking down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' is not a direction here: it means in high spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Something elongated has been lengthened, drawn out further than before.

clue.text: Articulate visionary author raised work awareness

parts.note: H G Wells wrote visionary science fiction

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means the letters go upward, i.e. are read in reverse

parts.note: op, opus, is a work
ken is knowledge, awareness

explanation.surface: A far-sighted novelist brought public attention to the subject of work.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone well-spoken expresses themselves fluently and clearly.

clue.text: Discharge former prince deposing country's leader

parts.note: ex means former

indicators.note: deposing means ousting from a place, here the prince takes over a letter's position
the leader of a word is its first letter, the one the prince displaces

parts.note: a nation is a country
Hal is Prince Hal, the young Henry V in Shakespeare

explanation.surface: An ex-prince overthrows the ruler of a nation.
explanation.walkthrough: Prince Hal is Shakespeare's name for the young Henry V; he takes the place of the country's first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An exhalation is breath or vapour given off, a discharge from lungs or ground.

clue.text: Transmission expert left to reflect during trial

indicators.note: during means in the middle of, so the reversed letters sit inside the trial

parts.note: a test is a trial

indicators.note: to reflect is to mirror, so the expert and left are read backwards

parts.note: an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: An expert witness leaves to think things over in the middle of a court case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to reflect' looks like thinking, but it means mirroring, turning the letters round.
explanation.definitionFit: A telecast is a television broadcast, something sent out over the air.

clue.text: Her majesty's personal units?

definitions.meaning: the royal speaks of herself as one

explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in the answer is ignored, as is usual: ONE'S and ONES.
explanation.definitionFit: The monarch's formal pronoun is one, and digits in the units column are the ones.

clue.text: Wino died after trip in dark, delirious

indicators.note: after says the letter for died comes behind the rest
in places the trip inside the scrambled letters
delirious means wildly confused, so the letters of dark are mixed up

parts.note: a run is a short trip

explanation.surface: A drinker dies after stumbling around in the dark, raving.
explanation.walkthrough: The scrambled letters of dark split around the trip, giving D then KAR on either side.
explanation.definitionFit: A wino is someone habitually drunk, especially on cheap wine.

clue.text: Bird initially leaving boat in flood

indicators.note: initially means at the start, taking the first letter of leaving

parts.note: Noah's ark was the boat that rode out the Flood

explanation.surface: A bird first flies off from a boat stranded by rising water, like Noah's dove.
explanation.definitionFit: The skylark is a songbird famous for singing high in flight.

clue.text: Prove unfaithful, as golfers typically do

definitions.meaning: golfers go out and ... of eighteen holes

explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is read as three words, play a round.
explanation.definitionFit: Playing around means cheating on a partner, while golfers literally complete a round of the course.

clue.text: Following check, I'm not sure it'll keep running

indicators.note: following says the hesitation comes after the word for check

parts.note: to stay is to check or halt
er is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: After a check, a speaker doubts something will keep going.
explanation.definitionFit: A stayer is a horse or runner with stamina for long distances.

clue.text: Government's current input to local pit conversion

indicators.note: input to means put into, so the current's letter enters the rearranged words
conversion means changing form, so the letters of local pit are rearranged

parts.note: I is the symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: Electricity being fed into a coal mine being converted for the local area.
explanation.definitionFit: Political means relating to government or the state and its affairs.

clue.text: Drink gallons, returning actual bottles

indicators.note: bottles means holds inside, so the reversed word contains the letter for gallons
returning means coming back, so actual's synonym is read backwards

parts.note: real means actual

explanation.surface: Someone drinks gallons and sends back the real bottles.
explanation.definitionFit: Lager is a pale beer, a common alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Record contribution to score

definitions.meaning: a musical score is made up of ...

explanation.walkthrough: 'score' looks like a game tally but is the written music.
explanation.definitionFit: A note is jotted down as a record, and each written pitch in sheet music is a note.

clue.text: Cathedral clergy dispensing with clothing shortly

indicators.note: removing the clothing strips off the outer letters, leaving the inside

parts.note: canons are clergy attached to a cathedral

explanation.surface: Cathedral clergy are about to disrobe.
explanation.definitionFit: Anon is an old-fashioned word for soon, in a little while.

clue.text: Warped tail of sick raven

indicators.note: the tail is the end, so only the last letter of sick

parts.note: raven-black means jet black, inky

explanation.surface: Describes the twisted tail of an ill raven.
explanation.definitionFit: Kinky means perverted or bent from the normal, and literally twisted.

clue.text: Railway employees endorse line in final agreement

parts.note: to sign a document is to endorse it

indicators.note: in places the letter for line inside the word of agreement

parts.note: amen is said at the end of a prayer to agree

explanation.surface: Railway staff back a policy that is part of a final deal.
explanation.definitionFit: Signalmen work signal boxes, controlling trains on the tracks.

clue.text: Lawman from New York seizing books artist brought back

indicators.note: seizing means grabbing hold, so the letters for New York wrap around the rest

parts.note: OT, the Old Testament, is a set of books

indicators.note: brought back means the artist's letters are read in reverse

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is the crossword's artist

explanation.surface: A New York lawyer grabs some books an artist returned.
explanation.definitionFit: A notary is a public official who certifies legal documents, a man of the law.

clue.text: Awfully strained buyer does it to upgrade

indicators.note: awfully means in a terrible way, so the letters of strained are put in a mess

explanation.surface: A shopper, badly stretched financially, swaps an old item for a better one.
explanation.definitionFit: A buyer who trades in an old car hands it over as part-payment for a newer, better one.
